2. This application has been filed for substitution of the deceased petitioner by her legal representatives.
3. Considering the grounds taken in the I.A. itself, the application for substitution is allowed.
4. The LRs of the petitioner be impleaded as petitioner nos. 1 (a) to 1 (d).
Consolidated copy of the cause title be filed in course of the day.
5. The I.A. stands disposed of.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (M.S. RAMAN) JUDGE Heard Mr. G.N. Sahu, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. J. Patnaik, learned Government Advocate for the State-opposite parties.

2. The petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking direction to opposite party no.1 to pay 1/3rd share of the compensation amount or in the altertnative refer the claim of the petitioners to the competent Civil Court for adjducation of their entitlement and share in respect of the acquired house/structure standing over Plot No. 513 under Khata No. 213 of Mouza- Kopsingha, in the district of Sundargarh.

3. Mr. G.N. Sahu, learned counsel for the petitioners contended that though the petitioners are entitled to get 1/3rd of the share of compensation, but due to non release of the same and/or non reference of the matter to the appropriate Civil Court for adjudication, the petitioners have Debaki Naik vs The Special Land Acquisition .....

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ... on 18 April, 2023

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35605028/
1 approached this Court in the present writ petition.

4. Mr. J. Patnaik, learned Government Advocate contended that there is no dispute that with regard to the claim of compensation amount, the matter has to be referred to competent civil Court for determination of the share of the parties.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, since the petitioners claim for 1/3rd share of compensation amount and that has to be adjudicated by the appropriate forum, thereby, this writ petition stands disposed of directing the opposite parties to refer the matter to the appropriate forum as provided under Section 30 of the L.A. Act for determination of the share of the petitioners and other co-sharers, so that the compensation amount can be released in favour of the petitioners.
